title: Maira’s Dream · 20 original thrift-store models
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Twenty original smooth low-poly meter-scale Y-up models, named overlapping scene children for prototype instantiation. Shelf, racks, clothing, housewares, tools, radio, furniture, register, extinguisher, black cat, cashier, shopper, gray clown manager and car. No external textures or photographic pixels.

title: Maira’s Dream · editable thrift-store model generators
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Twenty original texture-free Three.js thrift-store model generators. makePiece(kind,variant) returns ground-origin meter-scale Group. attach adds one model with update and dispose.

title: Maira’s Dream · shopping and escape rules
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Renderer-independent integer-cent budget, three affordable errands, basket, returns, price swapping and atomic checkout. Paid-inventory exit prerequisite, suspicion, extinguisher charge and timed fire escape. createRun(seed) exposes explicit actions and state. attach wraps run with update and dispose.
